title: Additive functoriality of Postnikov pages
statement: Let A and B be abelian categories, and suppose D(A) is a derived category with its standard t-structure. For every homological functor T:D(A)→B and every normalized canonical PostnikovCoupleData C, there exists PostnikovPageData C, realizing the canonical initial truncation maps and their image and homology iteration by additive functors. The witness interfaces are defined in [def-per-postnikov-additive-witness-data].

source.place: Tag 011Q, definition-exact-couple, together with its derived-couple iteration and morphisms; project E2/Postnikov indexing; agent generalization preserving the arguments of lem-per-bounded-above-rhom-hyperext.

proof.text: Naturality of truncation inclusions, quotient and boundary gives the three initial couple squares, including the coherent boundary shift. Conjugate by the given D/E comparisons. The initial functors preserve identities, composition and sums. Apply the generic additive exact-couple iteration and retain its defining successor squares. Uses [lem-sp-additive-exact-couple-pages], [lem-per-derived-standard-functors-additive], [def-per-postnikov-truncation-couple-terms].
